Z1 Demo Jobs

Every card below is judged by a computed check against an objective reference drawn on it: the job’s own design (outline overlay and under/over numbers), the app’s goal heightfield (deviation map and coverage), or a reference program swept the same way. No maker’s photo decides a verdict; the source line is provenance only.

Case Maker main 3c5a8184 · demo cards on loc-18df72f2aaf89730 “House + full Makera library (demo)” (134 cutters) · sample cards on “My shop” (29 owned cutters, the k3 export) · catalogue 129 cutters / 1328 feed rows, synced 2026-10-18T03:24:13.374Z · built 2026-11-03 03:21 UTC · no machine was used

The design check is this repo’s own sweep against the job’s design until #924 lands (the app’s independent oracle). The page is rebuilt on the pinned sha at every wave end; one command rebuilds it — tools/build.sh <sha>.

  • Matches the design21
  • Deviates6
  • Refused1
  • Not run0

The rule

A card stays only if its reference is objective and drawn on it, and its verdict is computed: Matches the design (verifier 0 errors, every measured item at its floor, nothing cut outside the design; 3D: zero cut-into the goal, coverage ≥ 95 %), Deviates (with the numbers and where), or Refused (the app’s sentence). Photo-judged verdicts and material proxies are retired; the as-filed job is judged.

Not reproducible here, so not cards: j06 wolf relief — input is CC BY-NC-ND (printables.com/model/1261158), not reproducible here; j08 rotary bust — cannot be described as a job yet (no 3D carving on the rotary); j09 PCB — needs a login and a board layout this shop cannot bring in; j26 split-helix — a pair of posted halves with no design to check them against.

The five hardwood samples (#936–#941, the 36 × 36 × 100 sticks)
